textos.texto: Today Ana is sick. She has a headache and she has a cold. Her head hurts and she has a cough. She also has a fever: it is thirty eight degrees. Laura says: you must go to the doctor. Ana goes to the hospital and the doctor asks: where does it hurt? My head and my back, says Ana. My eyes hurt too. The doctor has some medicine for her. You must sleep and drink a lot of water, he says. You must not go to work for two days. Ana comes back and she goes to bed. Her body is tired. She does not eat a lot: only soup. After two days she feels well again. Now she is healthy and she is happy. Her hands and her feet are cold, but she is fine!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Qué le dice el médico que debe hacer?
